title: Stasis Ritual
description: Three golden humanoid figures sit in a decaying room. The central male figure holds an open book labeled STASIS while yellow liquid drips from his chest; he is flanked by two females, one with wild hair throwing glowing yellow particles and another with a long braid and circular patterns on her back.
prompt: Three golden humanoid figures in a decaying derelict room with peeling walls covered in handwritten notes. A central male figure with short hair holds an open book labeled STASIS, yellow liquid dripping from wounds on his chest and neck. To his left a female figure with wild flowing hair throws glowing yellow particles from her raised hand, wearing a golden cape. To his right a female figure with a long thick braid down her back has circular symbols on her skin and touches his shoulder. All three sit in a pool of glowing yellow substance on the floor surrounded by scattered papers, dramatic cinematic lighting with strong yellow highlights and dark shadows.
